title: Dizon orders immediate repair of damaged tail dike in flood-hit Minalin, Pampanga

blocks.text: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Vince Dizon on Monday ordered the immediate repair of a damaged tail dike in Minalin, Pampanga, warning that a breach could send water and lahar rushing toward the town proper.
